body:
## Summary

The `documents` profile keeps these direct identifiers and contact details unchanged. Other forms of the same values are detected, so these look like gaps and not a chosen limit. `docs/COVERAGE.md` does not list them.

## Reproduction (0.16.0)

```js
import { sanitize } from '@link-foundation/sensitive-data-sanitizer';
const text = (s) => sanitize(s, { profile: 'documents' }).text;
```

All values below are invented.

### Phones

| input | output |
|---|---|
| `тел.: 8-916-123-45-67` | unchanged |
| `тел 8(916)1234567` | unchanged |
| `8.916.123.45.67` | unchanged |
| `916-123-45-67` | unchanged |
| `моб.: 916 123 45 67` | unchanged |
| `WhatsApp: 916 123 45 67` | unchanged |
| `wa.me/79161234567` | unchanged |

Forms that are detected:

| input | output |
|---|---|
| `звоните 8 916 123-45-67` | `звоните [REDACTED]` |
| `тел. 8 (916) 123-45-67` | `тел. [REDACTED]` |
| `телефон: 9161234567` | `телефон: [REDACTED]` |
| `(916) 123-45-67` | `[REDACTED]` |

### Obfuscated email addresses

| input | output |
|---|---|
| `anna.smirnova(at)example.org` | unchanged |
| `anna.smirnova [at] example.org` | unchanged |
| `anna.smirnova собака example.org` | unchanged |
| `anna dot smirnova at example dot org` | unchanged |

### Messenger handles and social links

| input | output |
|---|---|
| `t.me/anna_smirnova` | unchanged |
| `https://t.me/anna_smirnova` | unchanged |
| `Telegram anna_smirnova` | unchanged |
| `телеграм: anna_smirnova` | unchanged |
| `tg: anna_smirnova` | unchanged |
| `skype: anna.smirnova91` | unchanged |
| `ник: anna_smirnova` | unchanged |
| `vk.com/id12345` | unchanged |
| `instagram.com/anna_smirnova` | unchanged |

`telegram: @anna_smirnova` is detected, so the handle is found only with an `@`.

### Identity and payment numbers

| input | output |
|---|---|
| `серия 4510 номер 123456` | unchanged |
| `код подразделения 770-001` | unchanged |
| `выдан ОВД Тверской 12.03.2010` | unchanged |
| `водительское удостоверение 77 12 345678` | unchanged |
| `в/у 77 12 345678` | unchanged |
| `Driver's license 77 12 345678` | unchanged |
| `ОМС 1234567890123456` | unchanged |
| `полис 1234567890123456` | unchanged |
| `счёт 40817810000000000001` | unchanged |
| `диплом № 123456` | unchanged |

## Expected

These forms are replaced in the `documents` profile, or `docs/COVERAGE.md` lists each one as a known limit.

## Acceptance

- Each unchanged row above is replaced, or documented as a limit.
- Ordinary text stays unchanged: `skype недоступен`, `доб. молока`, `карта сайта`, `Срок 34 дня`.
